title: I built a 4-level Backrooms horror game in 4 days, working with an AI. Feedback wanted
author: enlxxx
selftext:
I wanted to see what one person and an AI could build together in a few days, so I made Backrooms by AI with Claude. I directed it, tested everything and made some of the animations; the AI wrote the code and built the levels.  
What's in it:

4 levels, each one plays differently: a dark maze where you restore power, a pipe level with something that hunts by sound, a calm Poolrooms level, and a chase level to finish

Sanity, flashlight battery, stamina, lockers to hide in, notes to find

Works on PC and phones

It was only just finished, so there will be bugs. I'd really like to hear what breaks, what's confusing in the first minutes, and how it runs on your device.

Play it here: https://www.roblox.com/games/136633858627558

Happy to answer anything about how working with an AI on a game actually went.

Looks SUPER good in the main menu. Would like to have a loading screen so everything is loaded in before it switches to the different levels in the main menu, because the blocks loading in mid transition threw me off a little (pretty minor tbh)

Visually the game is really good and the atmosphere is perfect. Gonna play more later when I have more time
